**FINAL: FAIL (one material blocker). Do not integrate or mutate until corrected and re-verified.**

**Material:** `tools/isswf-job.mjs:37` silently `continue`s on every non-`100644/100755` ls-tree entry, so `baselineTree` (successor use at `:162`) drops Git `120000` symlinks, `160000` gitlinks, and trees. The `tools/job-successor.mjs:52-54` exact-tree/mode comparison then equates the lossy baseline digest with the symlink-aware candidate digest and proceeds to `publish` `:62`. Proven RED (`recovery-68-successor-symlink-red.json`, base `8a2ee5bb…`, input `aa75bdb7…`): extra symlink in successor targetBase reaches "successor slot already consumed" rather than rejecting the tree; only the pre-existing edge stopped preparation. In a fresh store the edge would be consumed and a worker launched from an unreviewed base — violating frozen contract bullet 3 (targetBase typed tree equals receipt tree). Security-relevant: arbitrary invisible symlink enters the protected-check workspace.

**Required bounded correction (only this):** strict flag on `baselineTree`, applied *only* at `:162`; strict mode throws on any entry that is not `100644/100755` blob, naming mode and path, never skipping. Public negatives must run fresh (no pre-existing edge) and assert refusal before edge consumption: `successors/` empty, `.prepare-*` count unchanged, predecessor root facts hash-identical; cover `120000` and `160000`; add a symlink-free positive control. Leave `:195`, `:290`, and review baselines unchanged. Re-freeze snapshot and re-run the existing five-file plus public-offline regressions afterward.

**Other finding:** none material. Previously grounded nonblocking items stand: successor path skips `claimAdmission`'s ambiguous/legacy binding scan; grant pins brief/offline checks transitively via `newInputSha`/`newJobSha256`.

Everything else audited passed: predecessor receipt/tree/modes/original-contract pins, budget-2 + uncertain-prior acknowledgment, write-once edge before prepare, exit-9 replay refusal, competing-one, read-only read/reconcile join, root records unchanged, same-runtime only, no chains/provider/GitHub/billing/general-recovery claim.
